# What 0212 converts, recorded before the conversion starts.
#
# Two kinds of row.
#
# `test` rows name the eleven Rust parity tests that drive a committed bash
# fixture, with the number of `#[test]` functions each carried when this
# baseline was taken and the fixture corpus it reads. 0212 converts these; the
# recorded count is what it attributes its own coverage against.
#
# `case` rows record the SET of case directories per fixture subdirectory. The
# per-directory counts 0212 needs are DERIVED from these names by
# bash_parity_baseline.rs and printed in its failure message — storing the
# numbers too is how the numeric copy goes stale and 0212 reads a wrong figure.
#
# The guard compares SETS, not a total. A bare count is simultaneously too
# strict — an unrelated work item adding a fixture reds the build with a
# misleading message — and too loose, since a delete plus an add nets to the
# same total and passes while the drift it exists to catch goes through.
#
# The corpus has two provenances and both must survive until 0212:
# work-item-project-remote/ came from 0170, work-item-sync-baseline/ from 0194.

test  cli/work/tests/normalise_parity.rs                       4   work-item-normalise
test  cli/work/tests/sync_classify.rs                          1   work-item-sync-classify.json
test  cli/work/tests/sync_decide.rs                            1   work-item-sync-decide.golden
test  cli/work/tests/sync_label_parity.rs                      2   work-item-sync-label.golden
test  cli/work/tests/sync_push_decide.rs                       1   work-item-push-decide.golden
test  cli/work-adapters/tests/diff_shellout_parity.rs          3   work-item-section-diff
test  cli/work-adapters/tests/sync_baseline_corpus.rs          1   work-item-sync-baseline
test  cli/work-adapters/tests/sync_baseline_shellout_parity.rs 1   work-item-sync-baseline
test  cli/work-adapters/tests/sync_working_copy_status.rs      7   (no committed fixture)
test  cli/work-cli/tests/cli_diff_parity.rs                    3   work-item-section-diff
test  cli/remote-projection/tests/parity.rs                    4   work-item-project-remote
